description: This file contains a test script for focusing on specific features of git diff, specifically the pickaxe options and regex matching. It sets up a repository, creates a 4KB file, and runs tests to verify behavior of diff commands with various options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a label and a command sequence.

methods.description: Updates the repository timestamp for testing purposes.
